free_tier.stated: not stated on https://cloud.google.com/products/compute/pricing/accelerator-optimized (read 2026-10-30): the page is a price sheet that bills every GPU machine type by the hour, for example a2-ultragpu-1g (one A100) at USD 5.06879789 an hour on demand, and prints no free allowance
free_tier.notes: The Free Tier document says 'GPUs and TPUs are not included in the Free Tier offer.', and a non-billable Free Trial account cannot add GPUs to VM instances, so the USD 300 Welcome credit does not reach a GPU before the account is upgraded; whether the credit pays for GPUs after the upgrade is unverified: the document does not say.

limits.value: one A100 (a2-ultragpu-1g) at USD 5.06879789 an hour on demand; eight-GPU H100 nodes at USD 88.490000119 an hour (a3-highgpu-8g) and USD 93.400712807 an hour (a3-megagpu-8g) on demand
no free-tier allowance applies to any GPU or TPU; billing starts with the first second

confidence_note: both the accelerator-optimized rate card and the free-features document were read on 2026-10-22. The page proves the per-GPU rate and the free-features document proves there is no free GPU allowance

evidence.proved: 'GPUs and TPUs are not included in the Free Tier offer. You are always charged for GPUs and TPUs that you add to VM instances' (free-features document), against the accelerator-optimized rate card read the same day: a2-ultragpu-1g at $5.06879789 an hour on demand
the accelerator-optimized price sheet bills a one-A100 a2-ultragpu-1g at USD 5.06879789 an hour on demand; the page prints no free allowance
evidence.quote: a2-ultragpu-1g | Nvidia A100 | GPUs: 1 vCPUs: 12 Memory: 170GB SSD: 275 GiB | $5.06879789 / 1 hour

evidence.proved: the Google Cloud Free Tier excludes GPUs
evidence.quote: GPUs and TPUs are not included in the Free Tier offer.

evidence.proved: while the billing account is a non-billable Free Trial account, GPUs cannot be added to VM instances

evidence.proved: an eight-H100 a3-highgpu-8g is billed USD 88.490000119 an hour on demand, below the a3-megagpu-8g at USD 93.400712807

session_cap.note: no free allowance and no session cap; a GPU VM bills until it is stopped or deleted
